title: Smart Data Models - FloodDefence, an extension of dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest
description: One line of flood defences: what it is built of, who keeps it and the flood it is designed for. Extends dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest: no Smart Data Model holds a flood defence structure.
$comment: allOf: dataModel.PointOfInterest/PointOfInterest's schema.json at commit 7e5e24963a142b9bf6fd15b144a0e24588217608 with its type set to FloodDefence, then the attributes the extension adds (T-4336). Generated by scripts/open-data/generate.py.
